subject: Conduit fee routing and DocuSign timeline for Nimbus reseller flow
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Conduit fee routing and DocuSign timeline for Nimbus reseller flow

Alice —

Thanks again for sending the draft order form. Quick note from our side: the team surfaced a gap in how fee routing will be represented in the order form when Nimbus is the marketplace operator and CloudHub is the ultimate reseller. Legal wants an explicit conduit mapping row so billing goes to Nimbus but invoicing/settlement flows back to CloudHub under the reseller carve.

Can you confirm whether Nimbus is willing to:
- Accept marketplace billing (gross) and issue monthly settlement invoices to CloudHub, or
- Prefer we route billing through Redwood and have CloudHub as the invoicing party?

Attached I uploaded a suggested mapping (accounting-conduit-mapping.xlsx) and a redline of the order form with two options marked. If you think DocuSign should go to your general contracts inbox + a finance recipient, say so and we’ll prepare the envelope.

Goal from Redwood: finalize mapping and DocuSign recipients by EOD Wednesday so sales/ops can lock order activation by next Monday.

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
Principal Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
(mobile) 415-555-0123

Attachments: accounting-conduit-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet), Nimbus_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (annotated PDF)
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Cloud Contracts <contracts@nimbuscloud.com>, CloudHub Finance <finance@cloudhub.io>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Conduit fee routing and DocuSign timeline for Nimbus reseller flow

Michael —

Appreciate the clear options and the mapping. Quick answers: Nimbus prefers to be the marketplace bill-to party (gross). We can issue a monthly settlement invoice to CloudHub but need the reconciliation fields included (HubSpot deal ID, Redwood invoice reference, and SKU-level breakout).

I’ve looped in our contracts inbox and CloudHub finance (copied) so they can confirm the settlement cadence and data fields. Our contracts lead attached a short note with a single redline to your order form where they want the indemnity carve clarified for marketplace transactions (see: Nimbus_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf).

DocuSign recipients: please route to contracts@nimbuscloud.com and finance@cloudhub.io. If Redwood needs a separate copy to your accounting@redwood.com distribution, we can cc that address on routing.

We can aim for the EOD Wednesday timeline but CloudHub finance asked for one additional field in the invoice template (CloudHub customer reference) — hope that’s okay.

Best,
Alice Turner
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Nimbus Cloud

Attachments: Nimbus_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (single redline), signature-routing-docusign.pdf (proposed routing)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Conduit fee routing and DocuSign timeline for Nimbus reseller flow

Team —

I reviewed Alice’s redline and Nimbus’s preference to be gross bill-to. A few items for coordination before we sign:

1) Audit & evidence: we need a clause in the addendum that allows Redwood and CloudHub to access billing evidence for three years for reconciliation purposes. Recommend we add a narrow audit right scoped to settlement invoices and SKU mapping only.

2) Indemnity carve: Nimbus’s requested limitation around marketplace indemnity is acceptable provided there’s a carve for customer data breaches originating from reseller integrations. I placed a soft redline in the attached PDF (same file).

3) Invoice fields: agree to include CloudHub customer reference. Ops will need the exact CSV column names; I flagged this for Ben to handle.

4) DocuSign recipients: Contracts + Finance look fine. If Nimbus requires Redwood to be a signer, we should add an internal approver (Laura) to the DocuSign routing to speed turnaround.

If Ops (Ben) and Product/Platform (Karthik) confirm the SKU breakout and settlement cadence (net 30 or net 45), I’m comfortable moving to signature.

-kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Conduit fee routing and DocuSign timeline for Nimbus reseller flow

Michael/Kim —

Operations notes:
- Settlement cadence: CloudHub asked for monthly settlements, net 30 to CloudHub. We can support monthly gross bill to Nimbus and then issue settlement credits/invoices to CloudHub.
- CSV schema: I attached the recommended column headers in accounting-conduit-mapping.xlsx (column A: Redwood_invoice, column B: HubSpot_deal_id, column C: CloudHub_customer_ref, column D: SKU, column E: Gross_amount, column F: Settlement_amount). Please confirm column names are acceptable to CloudHub.
- Activation flow: once DocuSign is complete, ops will run a dry run in staging and confirm activation date + webhook mapping. Target activation: Monday 12 Apr if signatures by Thu EOD.

Approving DocuSign routing with Laura as internal approver. Laura — can you be ready to sign/approve if required?

- Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 15:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalizing mapping and DocuSign routing (RDW-DEAL-2027-042)

Thanks everyone — quick summary and asks: 

- Nimbus confirmed marketplace as gross bill-to; CloudHub will receive monthly settlement invoices.
- Ops agreed to the CSV schema Ben outlined. CloudHub: please confirm the exact column name you want for the customer ref by Thu 9 AM PT so we don't hold the envelope.
- Legal (Kim): add the narrow audit language + indemnity carve as redlines included in Nimbus_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf.
- DocuSign: route to contracts@nimbuscloud.com and finance@cloudhub.io; Redwood will cc accounting@redwood.com and Laura Bennett will be internal approver. Signature target: Thu EOD.

If there are no objections, I will prepare the DocuSign envelope and send to Nimbus contracts and CloudHub finance by 10 AM tomorrow. Moving to finalize.

Michael
Michael Grant
Principal Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
